description: This file defines the public interface for managing FreeType modules, including module flags, class structures, and functions for adding, removing, and querying modules and their properties. It also includes support for the TrueType bytecode engine type.

classes.name: FT_Module_Class
classes.description: Descriptor for a FreeType module, including flags, size, name, version, dependencies, and interface functions.

methods.name: FT_Add_Module
methods.description: Adds a new module to a FreeType library instance.

methods.name: FT_Get_Module
methods.description: Finds a module by its name within a library.

methods.name: FT_Remove_Module
methods.description: Removes a module from a library.

methods.name: FT_Property_Set
methods.description: Sets a property for a specific module.

methods.name: FT_Property_Get
methods.description: Retrieves a property value for a specific module.

methods.name: FT_Reference_Library
methods.description: Increments the reference counter of a library.

methods.name: FT_New_Library
methods.description: Creates a new FreeType library instance.

methods.name: FT_Done_Library
methods.description: Discards a library instance and releases resources.

methods.name: FT_Set_Debug_Hook
methods.description: Sets a debug hook function for font format interpreter debugging.

methods.name: FT_Get_TrueType_Engine_Type
methods.description: Returns the level of TrueType bytecode support in the library.
